title: Paloma Rewards Discount on the Cash Pickup Name-Correction Fee
content:
**Paloma Rewards benefit.** Members receive a discount on the fee for a recipient-name correction on a Cash Pickup transfer. It follows the tier of the sender's Paloma Rewards membership whose status is active.

| Sender's active Paloma Rewards tier | Discount taken off the name-correction fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Gold, Paloma Rewards Platinum, Paloma Rewards Diamond, Paloma Rewards Elite | 0.75 |
| Paloma Rewards Blue, Paloma Rewards Silver | 0.40 |
| no active membership | nothing |

**How it is taken off.** The discount is taken off the name-correction fee as a whole, meaning the tier's fee together with anything added to it. The fee never falls below zero, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

Hypothetical: on a fee of 5.00 as a whole, an active Platinum member pays 4.25 and an active Blue member pays 4.60. On a fee of 0.30 as a whole, an active Gold member pays 0.00.
